sourceTitle: The Finger of Fate: A Romance
description: "The Finger of Fate: A Romance" by Captain Mayne Reid is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around the lives of two half-brothers, Nigel and Henry Harding, who come from a well-to-do family stemming from their father, General Harding.
